findings.title: Cooperative close + one-block reorg lets a peer broadcast a revoked commitment
findings.reason: Version 0.20.1 is in the affected range < 0.21.0, but 1 condition can't be checked over RPC.
manual_checks: Exposure depends on peer behaviour no RPC shows. Check whether you have cooperatively closed channels with peers you do not trust, and whether you run a version with the fix patched in separately.
